sections.title: Sotsiaalteenuste osutamine kohaliku omavalitsuse poolt
sections.body: Local government obligation to provide social services: needs assessment, case management, 12 social service types.

sections.title: Koduteenus
sections.body: Home care service for elderly and disabled – assistance with daily activities in the person's own home.

sections.title: Üldhooldusteenus väljaspool kodu
sections.body: General care outside home – 24h care in care homes.

sections.title: Turvakoduteenus
sections.body: Safe house service for victims of domestic violence, trafficking, crisis situations.

sections.title: Erihoolekandeteenused
sections.body: Special care services for persons with severe mental disabilities: work support, supported living, community living, day/weekly care, 24h care.

sections.title: Asendushooldusteenus
sections.body: Substitute care services for children separated from parents – foster care, family-based care, care home.

sections.title: Toimetulekutoetus
sections.body: Subsistence benefit for persons in difficult economic circumstances. Base: €200/month for single person (2026 rate), higher for each additional family member. Covers housing costs within norms.

sections.title: Toimetulekutoetuse taotlemine
sections.body: Application for subsistence benefit submitted to local municipality. Decision within 10 working days. Paid monthly.

sections.title: Toimetulekutoetuse arvutamine
sections.body: Calculation: household income below subsistence level + eligible housing costs. Subsistence level set by Parliament.

sections.title: Vaidlustamine
sections.body: Appeal subsistence benefit decision within 30 days to local council; further to halduskohus.
